description: Asset-to-guard mapping for the mechanical VPS asset census (fleet-ops#1149). Classes are covered by default; explicit assets override. Every asset must name a live enforcer or a documented manual guard.

systemd-user-socket.guard: OnFailure=unit-escalation@%n.service drop-in (socket) + global escalation path, or documented manual guard

systemd-system-service.guard: system OnFailure or kernel/oomd-supervised, documented in escalation canary exclusions

systemd-system-timer.guard: system OnFailure or kernel/oomd-supervised, documented in escalation canary exclusions

systemd-system-path.guard: system OnFailure or kernel/oomd-supervised, documented in escalation canary exclusions

systemd-system-socket.guard: system OnFailure or kernel/oomd-supervised, documented in escalation canary exclusions

port-tcp.guard: process owner maps to a systemd unit with global escalation; unknown owners are a census finding
port-tcp.proof: bin/fleet-asset-census; ss; systemd user units; tests/fleet-asset-census.test.sh

port-udp.guard: process owner maps to a systemd unit with global escalation; unknown owners are a census finding
port-udp.proof: bin/fleet-asset-census; ss; systemd user units; tests/fleet-asset-census.test.sh

endpoint-key.guard: documented in config; validated by owning canary (HC -> heartbeat dead-man, CF -> cf-token, Telegram -> research)

storage-rclone.guard: rclone.conf versioned or backed by restic-r2-backup; restoration drill

test-suite.guard: referenced by a .github/workflows/*.yml job; unreferenced suites are auto-filed

test-header-claim.guard: extracted by fleet-asset-census; stale-claim detector manual review queue
test-header-claim.proof: bin/fleet-asset-census; tests/fleet-asset-census.test.sh; fleet-ops#1137 (docs claim extractor) applied to test headers
